title: acceptance-walker.sh: add scenarios for INVALID_CWD path, worktree-add collision, and prep-worktree walker mode (bugs #1, #2, #4)
definition_of_done: reference-impl/scripts/acceptance-walker.sh contains a scenario (or documented stub comment) for bug #1: probing that the walker skill now emits a WT path under $HOME and not /tmp/, causing INVALID_CWD if the old template were used

reference-impl/scripts/acceptance-walker.sh contains a scenario (or documented stub comment) for bug #2: asserting that no git worktree add ... main (named-branch) form appears in the Reviewer or QA prompts

reference-impl/scripts/acceptance-walker.sh contains a scenario (or documented stub comment) for bug #4: calling prep-worktree with a walker-worktree mainRoot and asserting it succeeds using the corrected node_modules resolution logic
All new scenarios pass (or stubs include an explanatory comment where a live claw-drive session is required)
acceptance_criteria: acceptance-walker.sh is updated per RFC AC #2: scenarios or stub comments cover bugs #1, #2, and #4; any gap is documented with a comment explaining why it cannot be exercised without a live claw-drive session

Bug #1 scenario: the script verifies that the WT variable in SKILL.md matches the XDG_CACHE_HOME pattern (static grep) or runs a mock invocation that would fail with INVALID_CWD against the old /tmp path
Bug #2 scenario: the script verifies that reviewer.md and qa.md contain no 'git worktree add.*main' pattern (static grep)
Bug #4 scenario: the script calls cloverleaf-cli prep-worktree with a simulated walker worktree path (or documents why the live call cannot be made) and asserts success
The acceptance script exits 0 on a fresh checkout after CLV-34 and CLV-37 are merged to main (RFC AC #2)
